rules.verified: The cited artifact was read or the experiment was run; this does not by itself make the result confirmatory.
rules.provisional: A genuine observed result whose receipt, sample size, split, or protocol is not yet adequate for a paper claim.
rules.immutability: Failed and superseded records remain present. Any changed artifact hash invalidates ledger validation.
rules.paper_admissibility: paper_role and limitations govern use in the manuscript; development-only results cannot be promoted without a new frozen protocol.
rules.code_retirement: A code path listed in code_retirement.code_paths was intentionally removed as stale after its immutable result artifacts were preserved. It remains in each original record to document the historical dependency and is not treated as unexpectedly missing.

P1-P8 should therefore be reported dimension-wise, with the scalar demoted.

No remote structured-generation smoke was run and no local generative model may substitute for it.

Across predeclared synthetic score probes, its clean macro relevant recall was 0.75 versus 0.9167 for fixed top-3; under single and false-consensus high-score poisoning it achieved 0% attack containment and 0% relevant-evidence recall versus 50% relevant recall for fixed top-3. The optimized poison was selected because the method intentionally chooses the highest-mean mixture component.

Multiple attacks per study cannot increase the independent CXR sample size.

records.claim: A public, unauthenticated, revision-pinned TAIX-Ray stream was used to freeze a scalable CXR safety test cohort without downloading the 1.33 TB repository. The cohort contains 500 radiographs from 500 distinct official-test patients: 100 moderate/severe pulmonary-congestion-only, 100 moderate/severe pleural-effusion-only, 50 with both findings, and 250 strict negatives. All 500 selected images have unique, verified content hashes. Questionable and mild target findings were excluded rather than mislabeled negative, and no model prediction, controller score, threshold, retrieval result, attack outcome, or generative call was read.

Keep IU-Xray as the pneumothorax/consolidation external endpoint.

records.claim: A strict modality-invariant transfer contract now replaces the invalid derm-flag-versus-CXR-score feature pairing. The source-frozen controller receives 14 identically defined, risk-directed features covering calibrated perception error, calibration-relative retrieval deficiency and image-evidence disagreement, retrieval flatness, provenance, injection, contradiction, KG support/quorum/topology/attestation, perception shift, and consumed agentic-loop budget. Only target perception calibration and clean label-free empirical CDFs for retrieval quality and cross-modal agreement may be fitted. Payloads containing labels, attack metadata, split, patient/study/case identifiers, or unknown fields fail closed.

records.claim: The first real-perception/source-frozen bidirectional transfer probe contained all held-out feature-level attacks and preserved matched clean accuracy, but the no-graph learned policy also contained every attack. KG incremental harm reduction was therefore exactly zero in both derm-to-CXR and CXR-to-derm directions, so both predeclared direction gates failed. The audit showed that V1's alleged graph attacks also exposed non-graph contradiction and retrieval anomalies, making the graph ablation uninformative.

V1 could not identify KG value because non-graph features made every held-out graph scenario detectable by the ablation.
Target evaluation uses a development/calibration split and cannot support a manuscript transfer result.

records.claim: After repairing the graph ablation with family-disjoint graph-only development and held-out attacks, the source-frozen transfer policy passed all four development gates in both directions using real train-OOF and calibration perception outputs. Full transfer produced zero first-action false reassurance on the deterministic held-out attacks; removing graph features raised overall attack false reassurance to 18.3% for derm-to-CXR and 11.9% for CXR-to-derm, driven by held-out edge inversion and false specialist-source quorum attacks. Matched clean accuracy changed by -0.68 and +0.32 percentage points, respectively. This promotes the architecture to a final rebuild but is not final clinical or end-to-end evidence.

limitations: The evidence attacks are deterministic feature-level stressors and are deliberately separable; perfect containment is a development sanity check, not an expected final effect size.
CXR target evaluation contains only ten independent high-acuity-positive cases, so uncertainty is large even though attacks create sixty positive rows.
Repeated attack families per case are not independent observations; all future intervals and tests must cluster by case.

limitations: THE REGISTERED v5 CONDITION FAILED. This is the primary registered outcome and it was not met. Unrestricted faithfulness did not merely fail to replicate its development result (+0.1236); it reversed to -0.2040 against MedGuard. Any account of this study that omits that sentence is misreporting it.

The mechanism was predicted in advance but its magnitude was not. The licensed corpus covers 3 of the 7 HAM classes, so guideline-eligible lesions fall from 57.5% of the class-balanced development set to 22.7% (339/1495) of the natural sealed distribution. MedGuard's unrestricted faithfulness is therefore dominated by answers a text judge cannot ground, and measures corpus coverage rather than faithfulness. B1 GAINED from the same distribution shift: its context recall rose from 0.1418 (development) to 0.4083 (sealed), because a benign lesion's label-derived reference is a bare diagnosis string that generic abstracts can support. MedGuard's context recall advantage consequently shrank from +0.3652 to +0.0691 -- still positive and still excluding zero, but an order of magnitude smaller.

v6 WAS REGISTERED BEFORE THIS RUN BUT AFTER SEEING DEVELOPMENT DATA, where scope-matched faithfulness already favoured MedGuard (+0.3395). That provenance is disclosed in the specification.
